title: flange.py
question: Do four M8 bolts at 20 N m keep this flange closed under a 30 kN pull?
about: Frames play in order of t. From t 0 to 1 the bolts are tightened to their preload; from 1 to 2 the external load comes on (values.load is its fraction). values.bolt_force_N lists each bolt's force in the order of bolts, which run from head_mm to nut_mm and are not part of the mesh. pressure is the contact pressure between parts, zero where the joint has opened; stress colours clip at the 99.5th percentile. mesh.body numbers the parts.
